name: Alt OI-flush beta (15m long the idiosyncratic-leverage washout)
rationale: MECHANISM: cascades hit high-leverage alts far harder than BTC (XRP perp OI crashed 96% off peak late-2025 while spot holders sat still). Alts carry disproportionate speculative leverage, so an OI flush there is a larger, more forced, more over-shot capitulation than the same flush in BTC — and the rebound is proportionally violent because the spot float that 'stays put' anchors the eventual snap-back. Counterparty: alt-specific liquidation flow with even thinner books, forced to sell into a vacuum. Edge persists because alt leverage repeatedly rebuilds and re-flushes (structural retail behavior). SPOT long on 15m. Entry: open_interest cross_down through a DEEP negative floor (bigger magnitude than the BTC-family H1 threshold) AND rsi below a low oversold floor AND ret_Nd below a negative floor (confirm falling) AND vol_realized above a floor (the violent regime). DISCONFIRMER: cross-asset ablation — if the SAME spec on BTC-only does just as well, 'alt idiosyncratic leverage' is not the driver and this is H1 on a wider universe; and PER-SYMBOL not pooled — if 1-2 symbols carry the net edge and the median alt is flat/negative after fees, it is an outlier artifact. Must survive BH-beat and maxDD <= 25% given alt volatility.
catalyst: deep alt OI cross_down flush + oversold + falling in the violent regime
